featured_reviews.name: Meghna Khandelwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently had a photoshoot for our twins at Shital Photo Studio in Versova, and the experience was truly wonderful. Handling kids, especially twins is no easy task, but the team was incredibly patient, warm, and understanding throughout the entire session.

I’d like to especially thank Raghav, Vaibhav, and Chaturthi for their support and kindness. They made us feel comfortable and ensured the kids were at ease, which really reflects in the beautiful pictures we received.

Another thing that stood out was their attention to hygiene and cleanliness, which gave us great peace of mind. The entire process was smooth, professional, and enjoyable.

We’re truly grateful for such a memorable experience and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a family photoshoot!

featured_reviews.name: Priya shanmugapriya
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had our newborn photoshoot done at home using their service, and the entire experience was wonderful. The team arrived right on time and carried out the shoot very smoothly and efficiently. They were especially impressive in the way they handled and calmed the babies—it honestly surprised us how easily they could swaddle them and help them fall asleep.

A special thanks to Sejal from the management team for her excellent coordination and clear communication throughout the process. The photographers, Vishal and Montu, were incredibly professional, patient, and skilled at what they do.
They also accommodated a few special requests we made without any hesitation, which we truly appreciated. Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and we would definitely recommend them. 💯

featured_reviews.name: varad gaikwad
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a wonderful experience at this studio! It was the first time we did a photoshoot for my sister’s baby in India. Since my sister is from Lithuania (Europe), she was a bit unsure about how the shoot would turn out, but the staff made us feel completely comfortable. Everyone was extremely friendly, and we chose the Janmashtami theme, which they executed beautifully.
My niece, Presha, was a little sleepy during the shoot as our slot was at 4 PM, but the team was so understanding — they suggested we let her nap and happily continued the shoot at 6 PM. There was no pressure regarding time slots or rushing through the session; the whole vibe was relaxed and pleasant.
Special thanks to the amazing photographers — Vishal, Chaturthi, Apeksha, and Chanchal — for making the experience so memorable!

featured_reviews.name: Vatsal Hemani
featured_reviews.review_text: Brilliant and highly cooperative team. We had an amazing experience of shooting with different concepts at the studio. We were so content with their service for our boy's new born baby shoot that we decided to have another shoot when our boy turned 1. Vishal and Montu had visited our home for new born shoot and they were the same two people who attended us for the other shoot. They both are extremely cooperative and talented. They managed the shoot very well and made our baby feel very comfortable. Shital Photo studio is absolutely the right choice for having new baby photo shoots. Extremely happy with their service. Cheers to Vishal, Montu and  team Shital Photo studio.

featured_reviews.name: Anuja Nikam
featured_reviews.review_text: The photographs are absolutely stunning! The lighting and poses are perfect, and I love how they capture my pregnancy glow...the comfortable and relaxed atmosphere, and the photographer's professionalism... Specially Thank you to Pranay Sir is very friendly and polite...also Thank you to the Shital photo studio team for the amazing shoot.... Highly recommended for maternity and baby shoot.😍😍

featured_reviews.name: Prashant Bankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wonderful Maternity Photoshoot Experience
We had our maternity photoshoot today, and I would like to share our wonderful experience..
From the very first enquiry the staff made us feel like a part of their family. They were extremely patient and never showed any sign of hesitation or tiredness in addressing our queries.
The Thane team is very hardworking and professional. During the photoshoot the music selection was excellent—very energetic and uplifting which made the entire experience even more enjoyable.
The team showed great respect and care, especially towards women, ensuring comfort and confidence throughout the shoot. The entire process was handled with great attention and positivity..
They also showed us how the photos were coming out during the shoot, which made us feel very satisfied and happy. The team guided us with different poses, made us smile and even helped create reels in a very easy and fun way without any rush.
A special thanks to Saurabh ji for his professionalism and dedication. He made the entire experience smooth and memorable.
Also, the makeup artist did an excellent job with the makeup and dress styling. The look was beautifully done and perfectly suited for the occasion.
The shoot location, car parking, and overall atmosphere were very hygienic, neat, and clean, which added to our comfort.
Overall, the amount we spent was absolutely worth it. After seeing all the photos today, we truly feel that every moment and every rupee was well spent.
Thank you Shital Photo Studio for making this day so special for us.❤️

All the best to the team. Keep up the good work 👍
